descriptions.en: Optional aspect prefix with trailing space; empty string when unused
descriptions.zh-CN: 可选画幅前缀，自带尾部空格；不用则空字符串

inputs.name: setting
examples: a neglected field behind a small Southern town, tall dry grass, an abandoned swing set, a distant church, humid cloudy afternoon
in front of a decaying farmhouse, overgrown yard, rusted farm tools, an old pickup truck, late summer heat
an abandoned county fairground in the American South, morning after a storm, muddy earth, rusted rides, torn banners, empty ticket booth, heavy humid air, gray sky

descriptions.en: Southern place, season and weather in one phrase; decayed working landscapes with humid heat
descriptions.zh-CN: 南方地点、季节与天气一句；带湿热的衰败劳作景观

inputs.name: subjects
examples: a teenage girl in a faded pale dress and worn sneakers, solemn expression, awkward posture of adolescence
a poor multigenerational white Southern family dressed plainly, serious expressions, no smiles, the grandmother seated in the center, children barefoot
a lone woman walking through the scene carrying a plastic bag, faded denim jacket

descriptions.en: The ordinary people, expressions, posture and wardrobe in one phrase; solemn, unposed, plainly dressed
descriptions.zh-CN: 普通人物、神态、姿态与衣着一句；肃穆、不摆拍、穿着朴素
